rawContent: I don't know how to feel.  These allegations against Biden are upsetting. If I say I hope they are not true, I get so angry at Ms. Reade. If I think they are true, I get so angry at Biden for running, esp. after #MeToo and putting victims like myself in this place.

@shameikmoore They have to stop killing us. Being black is not a problem. It shouldn't cost us our lives. I think you are tweeting this out of frustration, but this is not it. It's okay not to know everything, but please start by doing more reading and reading a room. #BlackLivesMatter
@radicalhearts Going through this in NYC. It's like #BLM only mean classed black people. Anything else should not be centered and in the shadows.
